Team — I reviewed Sophie’s redline set and added tracked changes. High-level legal stance below; please treat as our starting positions for the Friday triage.

1) Term and early termination
- We are open to an 18-month committed term, provided Exhibit C reflects the staged ramp and prorated billing on Day 0 for any overage. Oppose unilateral retroactive charges; any back-billing should have a 30-day cure period.

2) Indemnity & IP
- Do not accept a broad IP indemnity expansion. Counter-proposal: mutual indemnities limited to gross negligence and willful misconduct; carve out machine-learned model outputs (standard).

3) SLA credits and cap
- We will accept an SLA credit formula but need to cap systemic credit exposure to 30% of monthly fees per incident cohort. Sophie’s language removes the cap — we will push back.

4) Audit & data retention
- We can provide SOC2 reports and an attestable log extract but cannot commit to indefinite raw data retention. Offer: 90-day audit log retention for access requests + certified SOC2 + on-demand evidence package (with 3 business days' lead time).

5) Burst buffer / pricing
- Need Marissa and Karthik to confirm actual expected commit vs. burst. If Helix wants a guaranteed burst pool for 90 days, treat as a short-term add-on priced separately; we can include a temporary burst credit on the order form instead of re-pricing the base commit.

Attachments: I uploaded my tracked MSA (Helix_Agreement_MSAA_redline_v3.docx) and a revised Exhibit C template (Uplift_Capacity_Schedule_ExhibitC.xlsx) with suggested billing rows.

Please review changes inline and flag anything you want me to soften. If Friday works for a call, I’ll be on to own the legal side.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Commercial Legal
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Helix_Agreement_MSAA_redline_v3.docx (docx), Uplift_Capacity_Schedule_ExhibitC.xlsx (xlsx)
